scenarios.uniform-ledger: N unique event ids, identical recordFailure payload (tool/error ENOENT tool:read_file); one knowledge identity grows, so ledger growth is isolated
scenarios.diverse-knowledge: N unique event ids, target tool:target-<i>; one knowledge row per identity, so ledger and canonical knowledge grow together
scenarios.replay-duplicates: the uniform-ledger N rows replayed in order; duplicates must not add rows or bytes

method.clock: Date is pinned to CLOCK_BASE_MS + i*1000 before each write so A and B persist identical knowledge bodies; performance.now() timings are unaffected
method.latency: per-call performance.now() deltas; p50/p95 nearest-rank; rawMs kept for size 1000 only
method.checkpoint: write -> store.close() (last connection checkpoints and removes WAL) -> assert -wal absent/0 -> read-only DatabaseSync for dbstat/PRAGMA/fs.statSync
method.maintenance: no VACUUM, no ANALYZE, no manual checkpoint; measured state is what closing the store leaves
method.rounds: >= 3, alternating A/B then B/A, one isolated mkdtemp root per run

schemaSql: CREATE TABLE events (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, digest TEXT NOT NULL)
